note: Named plush NPCs in the Home zone. position is Apartment-local (+X west, +Z north) on the surface they rest on; facing is the direction they look (sit/stand) or their head points (lie); sit uses the shared seated pose (paws forward, slight recline). Optional back is an Apartment-local [x, z] point on the backrest face the sitter leans against. id is the character's permanent identity: unique, lowercase, never reused or changed once saves can refer to it (outfit choices, quests). name is only what the click popup shows, so rename freely, and several characters may share a name, species or scene as long as each has its own id. in_house: false keeps a character out of the house (14 Nov 2026, user: only the welcome tutorial's BonBon, Sunny and Leo stay there); the entry stays because every id is also a profile avatar and a tutorial stand-in, and its position is kept in case it moves back. "picker": false leaves a character off the new-player character grid (18 Nov 2026, user: the grid shows 8, not Sunny); saved profiles that use it still load.
